periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Ellipsoidal patches oriented at approximately 45 degrees downward and outward from the medial facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid geometry with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior-lateral taper extending downward from the geometric center of the eye patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior edge with a broad, relatively flat profile across the spinal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Transverse dark band covering approximately 30-35% of the visible cranio-caudal torso segment.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal gap between dark pinna regions, roughly equivalent to twice the width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex semi-circular arc with subtle flattening at the dorsal-most apex points.

other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrical prone posture with thoracic limbs fully extended anteriorly and head resting on the substrate.
